# MVC controller names (the class name without "Controller") that a plugin controller must never use.
# Jellyfin Enhanced 12.8's global response filters key on the MVC "controller" and "action" route values, so a plugin
# controller named like a core one gets JE's Hidden Content filtering and Spoiler Guard stripping.
# Read by kit/testsupport/Api/ControllerNameChecks.cs; compared case-insensitively.
